result.summary: The layout is largely consistent and functional. The main defect is an inconsistent favorite (heart) button treatment between the two 'Popular right now' cards, plus a minor thumbnail styling mismatch in the 'Fastest near you' carousel.

issues.description: The favorite/heart buttons on the two 'Popular right now' cards use different styles: the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card has a white circular button with a dark outlined heart, while the pizza card below has a dark/transparent circular button with a white heart. This looks like a broken or mismatched component state, and the white-on-light-pizza-image heart also has weak contrast.
issues.suggestion: Use a single consistent favorite button style (same background fill, icon color, size, and shadow) across all restaurant cards, ensuring adequate contrast over any image.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the Green Bowl Poké thumbnail has a light gray/white background while the sibling thumbnails use dark backgrounds, making the row look visually uneven.
issues.suggestion: Normalize thumbnail background treatment (e.g., apply the same dark overlay/backdrop) so all carousel images have consistent tone and the white duration badge stays legible.
